positioning.en: I connect mobile systems, full-stack delivery, and software Agents with reviewable code and executable evidence.
positioning.zh-Hant: 我把行動系統、全端交付與軟體 Agent 連在一起，用可審查 Code 與可執行證據交付。

settlement.en: The remaining balance is due after the agreed checks pass.
settlement.zh-Hant: 約定檢查通過後結清尾款。

evaluationFramework.source: 評估 Agent 應用與 Vibe Coding.pdf

note.en: Weights score a measured Agent task or delivery slice. They are not personal completion percentages.
note.zh-Hant: 權重用來評估一個具體 Agent 任務或交付切片，不是個人能力完成百分比。

summary.en: Android lifecycle, networking, WebRTC, release work, and production debugging.
summary.zh-Hant: Android 生命週期、網路、WebRTC、發佈流程與正式環境除錯。

nextProof.en: Keep public case studies separate from confidential production history.
nextProof.zh-Hant: 持續增加公開 Case Study，同時與機密正式工作經歷保持邊界。

summary.en: Typed APIs, web interfaces, data stores, CI, and small reviewable pull requests.
summary.zh-Hant: 型別化 API、網頁介面、資料儲存、CI 與小型可審查 Pull Request。

nextProof.en: More end-to-end public cases with before/after acceptance evidence.
nextProof.zh-Hant: 增加具備前後比較與驗收證據的公開端到端案例。

summary.en: Repeatable Android and iOS actions and checks on simulators or real devices.
summary.zh-Hant: 在 Android 與 iOS 模擬器或真機上執行可重複操作與檢查。

nextProof.en: A sanitized public device-automation demo with repeatable runtime receipts.
nextProof.zh-Hant: 一個去敏後可公開、具有可重播 Runtime Receipt 的裝置自動化 Demo。

summary.en: State, tools, retries, human approval, limits, and failure recovery.
summary.zh-Hant: 狀態、工具、重試、人工確認、限制與失敗恢復。

nextProof.en: A public end-to-end operator with live telemetry and external usage.
nextProof.zh-Hant: 公開端到端 Operator，具備 Live Telemetry 與外部使用證據。

summary.en: Reusable SKILL.md packages with code execution and assertions.
summary.zh-Hant: 可重用的 SKILL.md 套件，包含程式執行與斷言檢查。

nextProof.en: Broader cross-agent runtime qualification on externally reproduced tasks.
nextProof.zh-Hant: 在外部可重現任務上增加跨 Agent Runtime Qualification。

summary.en: Tests, schemas, evidence records, and fail-closed delivery gates.
summary.zh-Hant: 測試、Schema、證據紀錄與失敗即停止的交付檢查。

nextProof.en: More production-derived edge cases and independently reproduced evidence.
nextProof.zh-Hant: 增加由真實環境異常回流的 Edge Cases 與獨立重現證據。

summary.en: Executable capability audits, SKILL.md code/assertion loops, runtime evidence, and explicit non-claims for gaps that are not yet proven.
summary.zh-Hant: 可執行能力審計、SKILL.md Code／Assertion Loop、Runtime 證據，以及對尚未證明缺口的明確不宣稱。

summary.en: Portable Skill contracts, deterministic repository gates, qualification state separation, and preregistered evaluation work.
summary.zh-Hant: Portable Skill Contract、確定性 Repository Gate、Qualification 狀態分離與 Preregistered Evaluation。

summary.en: Executable evaluation contracts, deterministic reproduction, negative controls, and evidence boundaries for generated repository documentation.
summary.zh-Hant: 針對自動產生 Repository 文件的可執行 Evaluation Contract、Deterministic Reproduction、Negative Controls 與證據邊界。

summary.en: Independent semantic admission, deterministic contracts, provider timeout ownership, and replayable evidence receipts.
summary.zh-Hant: Independent Semantic Admission、確定性 Contract、Provider Timeout Ownership 與可重播 Evidence Receipt。

summary.en: Replayable black-box system experiments that preserve failures, quarantine states, and explicit production non-claims.
summary.zh-Hant: 可重播黑盒系統實驗，保留失敗、Quarantine 狀態與明確 Production Non-claims。

summary.en: Fail-closed tool and sandbox checks, Git Town delivery evals, and evidence that keeps failed or unrun gates visible.
summary.zh-Hant: Fail-closed Tool／Sandbox 檢查、Git Town Delivery Evals，以及不隱藏 Failed／Not-run Gate 的證據。

summary.en: Fail-closed provider preflight, evidence-bound recovery planning, and deterministic local reference flows without pretending they are live provider proof.
summary.zh-Hant: Fail-closed Provider Preflight、Evidence-bound Recovery Planning 與 Deterministic Local Reference Flow，不把它們冒充 Live Provider 證據。

summary.en: Content-addressed offline evaluation, signed evidence plans, strict state separation, and no claim of live trading or production authority.
summary.zh-Hant: Content-addressed Offline Evaluation、Signed Evidence Plan、嚴格狀態分離，且不宣稱 Live Trading 或 Production Authority。

area.zh-Hant: Android 與 iOS 自動化

summary.en: Implementation details for repeatable device control, integration, and Agent-assisted testing stay in the local Forgejo lane. The public portfolio uses only a capability summary.
summary.zh-Hant: 可重複裝置控制、整合與 Agent 輔助測試的實作細節留在本地 Forgejo 線；公開履歷只使用能力摘要。

summary.en: State-machine control, receipt-derived status, stacked delivery checks, origin verification, and bounded Agent consumer canaries stay in the local Forgejo lane. The public portfolio uses only an evidence summary.
summary.zh-Hant: 狀態機控制、Receipt-derived Status、Stacked Delivery 檢查、Origin Verification 與有邊界的 Agent Consumer Canary 留在本地 Forgejo 線；公開履歷只使用證據摘要。
